Clean the disconnectors from the dust and replace the old 
 grease

Clean the surface of the insulators and porcelain rods from 
 dust and dirt
Check the insulator from cracks and replace them if necessary
Check the contacts pressure conductivity of unit disconnectors
Clean the contact blades that reclaim damage parts

Replace graphite grease on moving and fixed contacts surfaces 
 of dissconectors

Tight the bolts and nuts on the moving contacts and fixed 
 contacts

Make sure that operation of the discorrectors is reliable by 
 closing and opening of the circuit for several times

Check the situation of grease for contacts of earth 
 disconnectors

Clean the earth disconnector contacts blades if any parts be 
 found burn or damage replace them
Check the contacts pressure of earth disconnector blades

Replace the grease by new one on the friction parts of the 
 earth disconnector and operating mechanism

Make sure that operations of the earth discorrector is 
 reliable by closing and opening of the circuit for several times
Make sure that the earth disconnector blades correctly
